boundaries.purge: Reject samples whose actual entry/exit cross the assigned interval or whose label is not fully known by fit cutoff
boundaries.development_embargo: Apply the registered gap per validation fold only if required by the frozen protocol; record actual scored dates and do not fabricate full-year invested performance.
boundaries.final_evaluation_embargo: Apply the registered entry gap once at2024 start if required; no automatic annual cash gap in2025 or2026.
boundaries.rebalance_phase: Derive from the first eligible signal after the relevant gap; never select a phase from performance
boundaries.embargo_policy: Derive and freeze from maximum label span, entry/exit delays and overlap before any performance evaluation; no inherited fixed20-session value.

final_evaluation.evaluation_type: one continuous sequential evaluation of a frozen annual eight-year refitting procedure
